# Implementation Plan: SCons Project Skeleton

**Branch**: `001-scons-project-skeleton` | **Date**: 2026-04-06 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/001-scons-project-skeleton/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by the `/speckit.plan` command.

## Summary

Establish the foundational directory structure and SCons build system for the Stoner Graphics Lab engine. The skeleton implements a 5-layer architecture (Core, Application, Renderer, RHI, Backend) with strict adjacent-only dependencies, static library per layer, cross-platform toolchain detection, and Debug/Release build configurations. All directories, `SConscript` files, and placeholder stubs will be created so that `scons` produces valid build artifacts from a clean checkout on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: C++20 (Modern C++, as per constitution)
**Primary Dependencies**: SCons 4.10.1 (build system only — no runtime dependencies for skeleton)
**Storage**: N/A (build system feature, no persistent storage)
**Testing**: Manual build verification on 3 platforms; placeholder test executable in `Tests/`
**Target Platform**: Windows (MSVC), macOS (Apple Clang), Linux (GCC/Clang)
**Project Type**: Library (engine skeleton producing static libraries + test executable)
**Performance Goals**: N/A for skeleton (build time < 30s for placeholder stubs)
**Constraints**: SCons 4.10.1 minimum; C++20 standard; no external package manager
**Scale/Scope**: ~50 files (build scripts + placeholder stubs), 5 layer libraries + 7 backend sub-libraries

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

- [x] **Spec-Driven Development**: Spec written, clarified (5 decisions), and approved before planning.
- [x] **Decoupled Architecture**: 5-layer architecture enforces strict `Application → Renderer → RHI ← Backend` with Core shared. Physical directory separation + build-level include path enforcement.
- [x] **Design Pattern Discipline**: Build system uses Composite pattern (hierarchical SConscript). No monolithic scripts. Each layer is an independent compilation unit.
- [x] **Multi-API Support**: All 7 backend placeholders (Vulkan, DX12, DX11, Metal, OpenGL, GLES, WebGL) pre-allocated under `Source/Backend/`.
- [x] **Advanced Graphics Readiness**: Renderer layer includes `RayTracing/`, `Meshlets/`, `GI/` sub-directories.
- [x] **Naming Conventions**: PascalCase for all C++ directories and source files. SCons conventions for build files (`SConstruct`, `SConscript`).
- [x] **Cross-Platform Compatibility**: Build system auto-detects OS and toolchain. Platform-specific flags handled in build scripts, not by developer.

**Gate Status**: ✅ PASSED — No violations. Proceeding to Phase 0.

**Structure Decision**: Flat `Source/` root with 5 layer directories. Each layer uses `Public/` and `Private/` sub-directories to separate interface headers from implementation, following UE5 conventions. `Site_Scons/` holds reusable build tool modules. Vulkan backend has a full stub implementation; other backends have `SConscript` + `.gitkeep` placeholders.
